entries.zh: 投詞：投遞狀詞，提出申訴或控告。
entries.en: to want to lodge a plaint; to be minded to file a complaint.
entries.notes: L 欄「Uar-se」費解，疑為 quejarse（告狀）之縮寫並以方框示疑；釋義依 H／M 欄。

entries.zh: 投傍：投靠、依附，尋求庇護或依靠。
entries.en: to seek support or protection; to attach oneself to someone.
entries.notes: L 欄空白，僅存 H「投傍」與 M「tāu pūng」；「傍」取依傍義，詞義未能確證。

entries.zh: 首告：出首告發，具狀向官府控告。
entries.en: to want to lodge a complaint in writing; to inform against.
entries.notes: L 欄「poreScrivo~」即 por escrito（書面）；「Uarse」同上條，釋義依 H／R 欄。

entries.en: to love; to want, to desire.
entries.notes: R 欄作「chong」，與「愛」之官話對音不合，疑竄行或誤摹；L／H／M 三欄一致。

entries.en: to desire; to want.
to be willing; to consent.
to consent; to permit.
to be willing; wish, desire.
to be glad to; to enjoy; joy.
to want; to need.
to entreat; to seek earnestly.
entries.notes: L 欄為 querer de corazón，H 欄「干」與之對應不顯，暫取干求義；M 欄有圈注示疑。

entries.en: to be to one's liking; to suit.
entries.notes: L 欄空白，承前 querer；依 H 欄「適」之「合意」義推斷。

entries.zh: 興：興致、興趣；因利而起的意願。
entries.en: interest, keenness; to want for gain.

entries.zh: 肯允：願意應允，樂意同意。
entries.en: to be willing and consent; to agree gladly.
to assent; to comply, to go along.
entries.notes: L 欄僅存方框「querer-」，H「就頭」詞義不彰，暫依 querer 同意語境推定。

entries.en: to permit him; to allow him.

entries.zh: 意願：意願、心願；閩語又作「情願」。
entries.en: will, wish; willingness (also 情願).

entries.zh: 專心：專心一意，全心全意。
entries.en: wholeheartedly; with undivided attention.
heart's wish; desire.
willingly; contentedly; of one's own accord.
to be willing; willingly.
